description: Starts sending the caller outage alerts for one provider, either from the tracked catalog or from their own custom providers. Requires an API key. A new watch is added to the owner's email alert. An existing alert counts only when delivery is allowed; otherwise a new owner-email watch is added or the request is refused with an explanation. A successful result always means delivery is allowed and reports the alert's channel. Other channels are set up on the account page; their destination URLs are never returned.

provider.description: A tracked provider (slug, name, or product name) or one of the caller's own custom providers.

name: watch_provider
title: Watch a provider
